name: ExtractDataFromWebPage
label: Extract Data From Web Page
description: Extracts data from a specified UI element on a web page using configurable parameters.

fields.name: WebBrowserInstance
fields.label: Web Browser Instance
fields.description: Enter or choose the variable that contains the web browser instance to work with.

fields.name: FindType
fields.label: Find Type
fields.description: Specifies how to find the element (e.g., ID, XPath, CssSelector).

selectOptions.label: Relative
selectOptions.description: Find by relative position to another element

selectOptions.label: Automation Id
selectOptions.description: Find by element's automation ID (for WPF/UWP apps)

fields.name: ValueToFind
fields.label: Value To Find
fields.description: The selector used to locate the link or button on the web page.

fields.name: ExtractionMode
fields.label: Extraction Mode
fields.description: Specifies what type of data to extract (e.g., single value, list, table).

selectOptions.label: Single Value
selectOptions.description: Extracts a single text value from the web page.

selectOptions.label: Handpicked Values
selectOptions.description: Extracts manually selected values from multiple elements.

selectOptions.label: List
selectOptions.description: Extracts a list of items from repeated elements.

selectOptions.label: Table
selectOptions.description: Extracts tabular data from a web table.

selectOptions.label: Entire HTML Table
selectOptions.description: Extracts the complete HTML table structure.

fields.name: UsePaging
fields.label: Use Paging
fields.description: If true, processes multiple pages by navigating through pagination.

fields.name: GetAllWebPages
fields.label: Get All Web Pages
fields.description: If true, extracts data from all available pages. Otherwise, only the first page is used.

fields.name: MaxWebPagesToProcess
fields.label: Max Web Pages To Process
fields.description: The maximum number of web pages to process when using 'Use Paging'.

fields.name: PageCssSelector
fields.label: Page CSS Selector
fields.description: CSS selector used to locate the next page navigation element.

fields.name: SendPhysicalClickForNextPage
fields.label: Send Physical Click for Next Page
fields.description: If true, simulates physical mouse click to navigate to the next page.

fields.name: ProcessDataUponExtraction
fields.label: Process Data Upon Extraction
fields.description: If true, processes the data to match visual display (e.g., handles hidden elements). Not recommended for large datasets.

fields.name: Timeout
fields.label: Timeout Seconds
fields.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for an element before failing.

fields.name: DataFromWebPageOutput
fields.label: Data From Web Page Output
fields.description: Returns the extracted data as a single value, list, data row, or data table.
